fundamental_and_reference.Definition

Defines the Fundamental and Reference data to retrieve.

Available as lseg.data.content.fundamental_and_reference.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    universe: StrStrings,
    fields: StrStrings,
    parameters: OptDict = None,
    row_headers: OptRowHeaders = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
    header_type: HeaderType = HeaderType.TITLE,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
universe StrStrings Yes Single instrument or list of instruments.
fields StrStrings Yes Single field or list of fields.
parameters OptDict No None Fields global parameters.
row_headers OptRowHeaders No None Output/layout parameters to add to the underlying request. Put headers to rows in the response.
extended_params ExtendedParams No None Specifies the parameters that will be merged with the request.
header_type HeaderType No HeaderType.TITLE Specifies the header key to use in the response.

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None Callable function to process the retrieved data.
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

make_on_response

Wraps a callback so that it is not called for intermediate ticket responses.

make_on_response(callback: Callable) -> Callable

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
callback Callable Yes User-defined callback function to process the received response.

Returns

Callable

Function that calls the callback only when the response does not contain a ticket.

Example

from lseg.data.content import fundamental_and_reference
definition = fundamental_and_reference.Definition(["IBM"], ["TR.Volume"])
definition.get_data()

# Using get_data_async

import asyncio
task = definition.get_data_async()
response = asyncio.run(task)
